The company offers a secure and user-friendly trading environment designed for both new and experienced traders. Team members collaborate in a dynamic, fast-paced setting, contributing to continuous service improvements and client satisfaction. Joining Errante means being part of a company that values integrity, professionalism, and client-centric solutions. Role Description The Account Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Limassol. In this position, the Account Manager manages client relationships, responds to inquiries, and supports clients throughout their trading journey. Daily tasks include onboarding new clients, explaining products and services, and ensuring clients have a clear understanding of trading conditions and tools. The role involves proactive communication via phone, email, and online platforms to address client needs, resolve issues, and promote client retention. The Account Manager also collaborates with internal teams to share client feedback, support sales and marketing initiatives, and maintain accurate records within CRM and other systems. Organizational and time-management skills to manage multiple client accounts, follow up on leads, and meet service and performance targets. Good understanding of online trading, financial markets, or brokerage services; prior experience in a similar role within financial services is an advantage. Proficiency with CRM platforms, email and office productivity tools, and the ability to maintain accurate and up-to-date client records. Fluency in English; additional languages commonly used in the trading industry are considered beneficial. Ability to work on-site in Limassol, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and adapt to a fast-paced, client-focused environment. Relevant diploma or degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent professional experience.

review_candidates.description: The Egypt Head of IT / Commercial IT Director is the senior country IT leader and single point of contact for all IT-related matters to the local business. The role translates global, regional and MEA strategies into market execution while aligning the country agenda to the new IT transformation priorities: product and platform ownership, speed and agility, responsible AI adoption, reusable technology capabilities, operational observability, and simplification for value. The Director is accountable for technology strategy, delivery, governance, risk, service reliability and adoption that enable commercial growth, customer engagement, productivity and business technology transformation in Egypt. Key Responsibilities Strategy, country leadership and business partnership: Lead the Egypt Commercial IT strategy, roadmap and investment agenda as a member of the Country Senior Leadership Team. Advise business leaders on technology-enabled opportunities, risks and trade-offs, and ensure IT remains the trusted local entry point for all market technology matters. Product and platform ownership: Establish clear ownership for country products, platforms and technical capabilities, clarifying the role of product owners, platform owners and business stakeholders. Drive lifecycle management, prioritization, value realization and adoption across commercial and cross-functional platforms. Speed, agility and simplification for value: Lead with pace and comfort in uncertainty, simplifying processes and technology choices to improve speed, agility and business value rather than reducing complexity for cost alone. Remove duplication and focus scarce capacity on the highest-value priorities. Business outcomes and portfolio value: Translate business goals into an integrated portfolio of technology initiatives, delivering measurable outcomes in revenue growth, productivity, customer engagement, operational efficiency and cost optimization. Track benefits realization and ensure technology investments directly support brand, key account, field force and channel strategies. AI adoption and automation: Accelerate responsible adoption of AI, automation and data-enabled use cases in commercial and enabling functions. Champion the ambition for IT to be a benchmark for AI adoption while ensuring appropriate governance, privacy, security and change management. Forward-deployed engineering and reusable APIs: Partner closely with business teams to shape practical technology solutions, applying forward-deployed engineering principles where appropriate. Promote reusable APIs, integration patterns and shared capabilities so local solutions can scale and be reused rather than rebuilt. AIOps, observability and service excellence: Strengthen service management, observability, proactive monitoring, incident response and continuous improvement. Use data-driven operations and AIOps practices to improve reliability, performance, user satisfaction and business continuity. Data, security and compliance: Ensure adherence to global and local data privacy laws, compliance standards, cybersecurity protocols and audit requirements. Partner with Compliance, Legal, Information Security and Quality to remain audit-ready and regulatorily aligned. Architecture, integration and local innovation: Maintain alignment with enterprise architecture, standards, cloud governance and integration patterns while enabling local innovation where justified by value, risk and scalability. Balance global platform consistency with market-specific needs. Team leadership and capability building: Build, lead and develop a high-performing Egypt IT team. Reinvest in the team's skills for the world of AI, product/platform ways of working, data literacy, engineering discipline, delivery excellence and continuous improvement. Stakeholder engagement, change and adoption: Maintain strong collaboration with global and regional IT, Commercial leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. Communicate clearly on strategy, roadmaps, risks, dependencies and outcomes; lead change management to drive adoption and sustained business value. Financial management, governance and risk: Plan and manage IT budgets with strong financial governance. Optimize resource allocation, vendor management, contracts and commercial terms; oversee IT risk management, business continuity, disaster recovery and service governance for Egypt. Essential Skills / Experience Education: Bachelor's degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics). MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is desirable. Experience: 12+ years of progressive experience in IT roles, including 3+ years in leadership positions within multinational organizations, ideally in life sciences, healthcare or another regulated industry. Product and platform leadership: Proven experience with product/platform operating models, product ownership, platform lifecycle management, prioritization and value tracking. AI, data and automation: Strong understanding of AI-enabled business use cases, automation, analytics, data governance and responsible adoption in commercial or enterprise settings. Agile delivery and ambiguity: Track record leading large-scale programs and transformations with modern delivery practices, agile ways of working, and the ability to make progress despite uncertainty. Integration, architecture and APIs: Understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud governance, integration patterns and reusable API-led delivery. Service excellence and observability: Familiarity with ITIL, service management, AIOps, observability, proactive monitoring, incident response and business continuity practices. Governance, security and compliance: Strong grasp of data privacy, cybersecurity, identity and access management, SDLC/SLC, validation practices, ISO standards and audit readiness in local and global contexts. Executive presence: Strong influencing, advisory and communication skills with the ability to engage senior leaders, challenge constructively and drive decisions. People leadership: Demonstrated experience leading, coaching and developing teams in complex, matrixed environments, including both direct teams and cross-functional delivery teams. Financial acumen: Experience planning and managing budgets, vendor ecosystems, contracts, commercial terms and benefits tracking. Language: Fluency in English. Desirable Skills / Experience Experience in pharma, life sciences, healthcare or another regulated, highly matrixed environment. Hands-on exposure to global enterprise platforms such as CRM, analytics, data platforms, content management and marketing automation. Proven success scaling AI-enabled, automation, analytics or digital product/platform capabilities in commercial settings. Exposure to forward-deployed engineering, internal platforms or reusable API and product patterns. As a senior member of the team, you will act as an escalation point for live incidents, ensuring the reliability of systems that directly impact passenger travel and airline operations. Key Responsibilities System Integration: Design and maintain robust integrations with major PSS platforms (e.g., Amadeus Altéa, Sabre, Travelport, Navitaire, Radixx) and GDS networks. Core Development: Build and support systems managing reservations, ticketing, fare calculation, inventory/availability, PNR management, and revenue accounting using .NET. Messaging & Protocols: Implement solutions using industry-standard formats including EDIFACT, Type A/B messaging, NDC, and IATA standards (PADIS, AIDX). API Management: Develop and maintain high-performance interfaces between internal systems and external GDS/PSS endpoints (SOAP/REST, XML/JSON). Production Ownership: Own the triage, root cause analysis, and permanent resolution of GDS/PSS-related incidents. Troubleshoot PNR/ticketing discrepancies and message-queue failures. On-Call Leadership: Participate in an on-call rotation to provide rapid response for critical booking and ticketing systems. Strategic Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with revenue management, airport operations, and interline teams to translate complex business rules into technical specifications. Operational Excellence: Author and maintain technical runbooks, monitoring, and alerting systems to minimize recurring incidents and improve system stability. Mentorship: Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and influence architectural decisions for PSS/GDS-adjacent systems. Compliance: Ensure all developments align with IATA resolutions, interline agreements, and global data standards. Required Qualifications Extensive experience in software engineering using the .NET framework, with a focus on mission-critical, high-availability systems. Proven technical expertise in airline PSS/GDS integration (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport, etc.). Deep understanding of travel industry messaging standards (EDIFACT, Type A/B, XML, JSON). Demonstrated experience in production support and incident management within a high-pressure environment. Strong analytical skills with the ability to perform root cause analysis on complex distributed systems. Ability to translate complex airline business requirements into scalable, reliable technical solutions. Nice-to-Have Experience with NDC implementation (IATA NDC schemas, aggregators like Farelogix/Accelya). Exposure to interline/codeshare workflows, IROPS (irregular operations) handling, or revenue accounting reconciliation. Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker/Kubernetes). IATA or relevant airline industry certifications. Prior experience working directly with airline operations, revenue management, or customer service teams. What We Offer Competitive Compensation & Security: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage and end-of-service gratuity. Travel Benefits: Annual air ticket allowance to support your personal travel. Work-Life Balance: Generous paid time off (PTO) policy. Global Mobility: Full support for work visa sponsorship and relocation assistance where applicable.
